title: Code block that scrolls sideways
summary: overflow-x: auto on the block, and min-width: 0 on its flex parent, so a long token scrolls instead of widening the page.
explanation: A long unbroken token does not wrap, so it runs past the edge of its box. overflow-x: auto gives the block its own scrollbar, so only the block scrolls and the page layout stays put.

The block sits in a flex row next to a label. Flex items default to min-width: auto, which lets the block grow to fit its content and push the label off screen. min-width: 0 stops that, so the block keeps the space it was given.
tryThis: Remove overflow-x: auto from .code: the long token spills out of the frame.
Remove min-width: 0 from .code: the whole row grows wider than the frame.
Shorten the token to a few words and watch the scrollbar disappear.
